;Disasters and accidents
*[[2020 Atlantic hurricane season]]
**[[Hurricane Delta]]
***Hurricane Delta makes landfall in [[Mexico]]'s [[Yucatán Peninsula]] at 5:30 CDT. [https://weather.com/storms/hurricane/news/2020-10-07-hurricane-delta-forecast-us-gulf-coast-yucatan-peninsula-0 (The Weather Channel)]
***[[Carlos Joaquín González]], governor of [[Quintana Roo]], says that "half of the state is without power" due to Hurricane Delta. [https://weather.com/news/news/2020-10-06-hurricane-delta-mexico-cancun-cozumel-yucatan-damage-landfall (The Weather Channel)]
***[[New Iberia, Louisiana]], issues a city wide curfew as Hurricane Delta approaches. [https://www.klfy.com/local/curfews-in-acadiana-due-to-hurricane-delta/ (KLFY-TV)]
*[[Russia]]n authorities evacuate people from over a dozen villages in the [[Ryazan Oblast]], following a large fire and explosions at a [[Russian Armed Forces|military]] [[Ammunition dump|arms depot]]. No casualties are reported. [https://uk.reuters.com/article/uk-russia-arms-fire/russia-evacuates-villages-as-huge-blaze-breaks-out-at-arms-depot-idUKKBN26S21D?il=0 (Reuters)]
*A bus accident leaves at least 18 people dead in [[Ivory Coast]]. [https://www.reuters.com/article/us-ivorycoast-accident-burkina/eighteen-burkinabe-nationals-die-in-ivory-coast-bus-crash-idUSKBN26S31I (Reuters)]

;Health and environment
*[[COVID-19 pandemic]]
**[[COVID-19 pandemic in Europe]]
***[[COVID-19 pandemic in Andorra]]
****The Andorran government orders all bars in the Principality to close and only offer food at home, and restricts the hours of restaurants between 12 p.m. and 4 p.m. local time, and between 7 p.m. and midnight local time. [https://www.elperiodic.ad/noticia/81514/els-bars-nomes-poden-oferir-servei-a-domicili (''El Periòdic'')]
***[[COVID-19 pandemic in Belgium]]
****The regional government in [[Brussels]] declares that bars and cafes in the city will be forced to close for a month effective tomorrow, even if they only sell tea or coffee, after the Belgian capital overtook [[Paris]] in terms of infections per inhabitant. [https://www.swissinfo.ch/eng/brussels-bars-and-cafes-to-close-as-covid-19-cases-resurge/46082326 (Swiss Info)]
***[[COVID-19 pandemic in Bulgaria]]
****[[Bulgaria]] registers 436 new cases in the past 24 hours, a record high for a single day since the beginning of the pandemic, as shown by data from the national information platform on the disease. A total of 22,306 cases have been registered in the country. [https://mobile.reuters.com/article/amp/idINKBN26S0VU (Reuters)]
***[[COVID-19 pandemic in the Czech Republic]]
****The [[Czech Republic]] reports a record 4,457 new cases in a single day, according to data from the [[Ministry of Health (Czech Republic)|Health Ministry]], as in infections over the past month are now rising at the fastest pace in Europe, seeing 326.8 per 100,000 over the past two weeks. [https://www.dailysabah.com/world/europe/czech-republic-sees-fastest-rise-in-new-coronavirus-cases-in-europe (''Daily Sabah'')]
***[[COVID-19 pandemic in France]]
****[[Minister of Health (France)|French health authorities]] reported 18,746 new confirmed cases in 24 hours, a new all-time daily high since the beginning of the outbreak, taking the nationwide total at 653,509. [[President of France|President]] [[Emmanuel Macron]] responded to that record cases by saying there will be a new restrictions to curb spread of the virus. [https://www.france24.com/en/20201007-covid-19-france-records-new-all-time-high-of-nearly-19-000-cases-in-24-hours (France 24)]  
***[[COVID-19 pandemic in Germany]]
****[[Berlin]]'s nightlife is facing a closing time for the first time since 1950, effective October 10, as bars, restaurants, and off-licences will have to close between 11:00 p.m. and 6:00 a.m. local time. Under new rules that have been announced, public gatherings of more than five people from more than two households, as well as private gatherings of more than ten people, will also be banned. [https://www.theguardian.com/world/2020/oct/07/berlin-nightlife-given-first-curfew-in-70-years-as-covid-cases-surge (''The Guardian'')]
***[[COVID-19 pandemic in Italy]]
****[[Italy]] imposes a compulsory nationwide outdoor mask mandate, with fines ranging from 400 to 1,000 [[euro]]s ([[Australian dollar|AS$]]659 to AS$1,650; US$463 to US$1,163) for violators in a bid to curb the second wave of [[COVID-19]]. This decree passes at the same time the country reports 3,678 cases in the last 24 hours, the highest figure since the peak of the outbreak in April. Exceptions include outdoor sporting activities, children under six years of age, and people with health conditions that preclude wearing masks. [https://www.smh.com.au/world/europe/italy-imposes-outdoor-mask-law-in-a-bid-to-curb-second-covid-19-wave-20201008-p56328.html (''Sydney Morning Herald'')] [https://abcnews.go.com/Health/wireStory/italy-eyes-mandate-masks-outdoors-virus-rebounds-73477405 (ABC News)]
***[[COVID-19 pandemic in Poland]]
****[[Poland]] reports 3,003 new cases and 75 new deaths in the last 24 hours. It is  the highest jump of number of cases and deadliest day since the start of the pandemic. [https://www.polskieradio.pl/395/7784/Artykul/2596747,Polands-COVID19-cases-deaths-surge-to-new-daily-highs (Radio Poland)]
***[[COVID-19 pandemic in Romania]]
****[[Romania]] records 2,958 new cases, as well as 82 deaths. It is the highest jump of number of cases and deadliest day since the start of the pandemic. [https://www.reuters.com/article/health-coronavirus-romania/romania-sees-coronavirus-spike-to-3000-new-daily-cases-idUSL8N2GY497 (Reuters)]
**[[COVID-19 pandemic in the United States]]
***[[COVID-19 pandemic in Wisconsin]]
****[[Governor of Wisconsin|Governor]] [[Tony Evers]] announces that the [[Wisconsin|state]] will open a [[field hospital]] at the state fairgrounds near [[Milwaukee]]. [https://thehill.com/changing-america/well-being/longevity/520066-wisconsin-to-open-field-hospital-as-covid-19 (''The Hill'')]
**[[COVID-19 pandemic in Brazil]]
***[[Brazil]] surpasses five million COVID-19 cases, becoming the third country to reach that milestone after the [[United States]] and [[India]]. [https://www.bloomberg.com/amp/news/articles/2020-10-07/brazil-cases-top-5-million-as-debate-shifts-from-virus-to-fiscal (Bloomberg)]
*[[Minister of Environment and Climate Change|Canadian Environment and Climate Change Minister]] [[Jonathan Wilkinson]] announces that [[Canada]] will ban [[plastic bags]], [[drinking straw]]s, [[cutlery]] and other [[Disposable product|single-use items]] by the end of 2021. [https://www.ctvnews.ca/climate-and-environment/canada-banning-plastic-bags-straws-cutlery-and-other-single-use-items-by-the-end-of-2021-1.5135968 (CTV)]

;International relations

**The [[U.S. Department of Justice]] announces the seizure of 92 [[domain name]]s believed to be used by the [[Islamic Revolutionary Guard Corps]] to "spread pro-Iranian disinformation". [https://www.middleeasteye.net/news/us-iran-seize-websites-fake-news (''Middle East Eye'')]

;Law and crime
*[[Indonesia omnibus bill protests]]
**[[Indonesian police]] detains nearly 400 protesters, some armed with [[molotov cocktails]] and sharp weapons. Demonstrations take place in at least 12 places, with police detaining 183 people outside local parliament in [[Palembang]], and holding more than 200 protesters in the capital [[Jakarta]]. [https://www.channelnewsasia.com/news/asia/indonesia-protests-jobs-law-omnibus-bill-demonstrations-13221370 (CNA)]
*[[George Floyd protests]]
**Ex-[[Minneapolis Police Department|police]] officer [[Derek Chauvin]], who was charged in [[George Floyd]]'s [[death of George Floyd|death]], is released on bail. [https://minnesota.cbslocal.com/2020/10/07/former-mpd-officer-derek-chauvin-charged-in-george-floyds-death-expected-to-post-bail-source-says/ (WCCO-TV)]
*A [[Greece|Greek]] court rules that [[far-right]] [[political party]] [[Golden Dawn (Greece)|Golden Dawn]] operated as a [[crime in Greece|criminal]] organization in connection with the murder of [[anti-fascist]] rapper [[Pavlos Fyssas]] in 2013 and other crimes. [https://www.cbsnews.com/news/greece-court-verdict-far-right-golden-dawn-party-criminal-organization-murder-rapper-anti-fascist/ (CBS News)]

;Politics and elections
*[[2020 Kyrgyzstani protests]], [[October 2020 Kyrgyz parliamentary election]]
**[[Kyrgyzstan|Kyrgyz]] parliamentarians launch [[impeachment]] procedures against [[President of Kyrgyzstan|President]] [[Sooronbay Jeenbekov]]. [https://sputniknews.com/asia/202010071080698598-kyrgyz-parliamentarians-launch-impeachment-procedure/ (Sputnik news)]
*Foreign Minister of [[Northern Cyprus]] [[Kudret Özersay]] resigns in protest of Prime Minister [[Ersin Tatar]]'s decision to re-open [[Varosha, Famagusta|Varosha]], a [[Greek Cypriots|Greek Cypriot]]-majority resort town that was abandoned after the [[Turkish invasion of Cyprus]] in 1974, days before [[2020 Northern Cypriot presidential election|the presidential election]]. He also pulled the [[People's Party (Northern Cyprus)|People's Party]] out of the ruling coalition late yesterday in light of the announcement. [https://english.alaraby.co.uk/english/news/2020/10/7/turkish-cypriot-fm-quits-in-protest (''The New Arab'')]

**The [[Nobel Prize]] in [[Chemistry]] is awarded to [[Emmanuelle Charpentier]] and [[Jennifer Doudna]] "for the development of a method for [[genome editing]]." [https://abcnews.go.com/Technology/wireStory/panel-announce-2020-nobel-prize-chemistry-73466890 (ABC)]
*[[2020 in archosaur paleontology]]
**Multiple skeletons of ''[[Oksoko avarsan]]'' are discovered in the [[Gobi Desert]] in [[Mongolia]]. [https://www.bbc.com/news/uk-scotland-edinburgh-east-fife-54448253 (BBC News)]
*[[Elon Musk's Tesla Roadster|Starman]], a [[Tesla Roadster (first generation)|Tesla Roadster]] that was launched on a [[Falcon Heavy]] rocket [[Falcon Heavy test flight|three years ago]] by [[Elon Musk]], makes its closest approach to [[Mars]] at a distance of 0.05 astronomical units. [https://www.cnn.com/2020/10/08/cars/spacex-tesla-mars-starman-scn-trnd/index.html (CNN)]
